title: Green synthesis of Aloe vera-assisted Co3O4 nanostructures: structural, electronic, optical, and electrochemical insights for supercapattery applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,28626-28641
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03604F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mohit Bhatt, Kajal Gautam, Payal Dhyani, A. K. Sinha
Aloe vera-assisted synthesis produces defect-rich Co3O4 nanostructures with high capacitance (467.9 F g−1 at 0.5 A g−1) and 83% retention after 3000 cycles for supercapattery applications.
